title: Cut inside: a real object opens to show its layers
goal:
A device that shows the inside of a real thing (_corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md 2.4). params: `image` (the real object's photo or render, a staged asset path), `layers` (2 to 6 items: {label, image?} from outside in), `axis` ('x' or 'y').

Verbs: enter (the whole object rises in), open (the object splits along `axis` and the layers lift apart in order, staggered 3 frames, each labelled small with a hairline, per 2.8), focus (one layer index scales to 1.15 while the others dim to 40%), close, exit.

## Tests
- before open no layer is offset; 12 frames after open every layer is apart and labelled
- focus dims every other layer and never the focused one
- close returns to the closed geometry
- tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame}), a pure function of its props; state only from stateAt(events, object.obj, frame); animation only from progress() and drift() with MOTION timing, and the helpers in kit/verbs.ts once they exist; colours only from tokens (raw hex refused); type roles from HOUSE_FONTS; no Math.random, no f % N, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in devices/registry.ts (one line) and in config/ve/devices.json with exactly the verbs below, and update verbs.test.ts. Follow the builder method in _corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md section 8: the picture comes from object.params (an image path for the real thing, its labels), never a generic shape standing in for it. Verbs, exactly: enter, open, focus, close, exit.
acceptance:
